name: Hanabusa Otone
source:
She has been married for 18 years, however, no one has ever seen her husband.

She is a mysterious woman living alone in Room 101. It is said that someone is threatening her, putting her under house arrest, and tormenting her, but she is not sure who it is.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532765]Getchu[/url]]
